pages.text: Shift-right-click to cycle between Attack, Follow, and Hold. Right-click to issue the selected order.$(br2)Attack orders the patrol against the target you are looking at. Follow regroups them. Hold assigns your current position for them to defend.
pages.title: Illager Warhorn
Obtaining
pages.text: The Illager Warhorn is made with the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l). It has a 2-second command cooldown.
